name: edge-blog
description: A fully dynamic, highly customizable blog system for Cloudflare Workers (React + Hono + D1 + R2 + KV).

JWT_SECRET.description: 用于签署登录会话（JWT）的密钥，至少 32 个字符。用 `openssl rand -base64 48` 生成，**不要保留示例值**；缺失或过短时后台接口会返回 500。

scripts.deploy: npm run build && node ./scripts/db-bootstrap.mjs && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --remote --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --remote --file=./migrations/0002_fts.sql && wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --remote --file=./migrations/0003_auth_hardening.sql && wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --remote --file=./migrations/0004_write_amplification.sql && wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --remote --file=./migrations/0005_audit_and_soft_delete.sql && wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --remote --file=./migrations/0006_media_thumbnail.sql && wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --remote --file=./migrations/0007_columns.sql && wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --remote --file=./migrations/0008_automation.sql && wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --remote --file=./migrations/0009_automation_cover_agent.sql
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --local --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --local --file=./migrations/0002_fts.sql && wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --local --file=./migrations/0003_auth_hardening.sql && wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --local --file=./migrations/0004_write_amplification.sql && wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --local --file=./migrations/0005_audit_and_soft_delete.sql && wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --local --file=./migrations/0006_media_thumbnail.sql && wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --local --file=./migrations/0007_columns.sql && wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --local --file=./migrations/0008_automation.sql && wrangler d1 execute edge-blog --local --file=./migrations/0009_automation_cover_agent.sql
